name: Chicken Cordon Bleu Bake
evidence: Catalog already carries chicken-cordon-bleu-casserole (chicken-breast + diced-ham + swiss-cheese + sour-cream), the same protein, the same cordon-bleu ham+swiss flavor family, and the same oven-bake method; only the starch differs (catalog has rice, this low-carb version drops it and swaps cream-of-chicken soup for a cream-cheese/parmesan/mayo sauce), which is 3-of-4 match with rice as mere filler, not a distinct dinner.

fit.note: 480 cal (400-650 ok), 5g carbs (<=35 ok), no seafood, scalable to 14 as a weigh-and-divide bake - clears the gate, but killed as a catalog duplicate regardless.

cross_protein_collisions: Structurally identical to the catalog's turkey-cordon-bleu-casserole (turkey-breast + diced-ham + swiss-cheese) - same cordon-bleu dish, different protein.
Any turkey- or pork-cordon-bleu bake in another selector's pool is the same dish; decider should watch for a turkey/pork cordon-bleu twin.
